t: This is Holloway Road tube station, on the Piccadilly line between Caledonian Road and Arsenal, in fare zone 2. It opened on 15 December 1906. Next to it is the site of the former Holloway and Caledonian Road railway station. The architect Leslie Green designed it. He is best known for the Underground stations he created in that decade, with their oxblood red faïence blocks, pillars, semi-circular first-floor windows, and patterned tiled interiors in the Modern Style.
